basic_info.description: Ideally located in the heart of Pacific Heights, 2864 Sacramento is a full-floor 3BD/2BA flat that blends modern updates with timeless period charm. Just blocks from Alta Plaza Park, Upper Fillmore, the Divisadero corridor, and Laurel Village including favorites like Spruce and B. Patisserie. This home offers elegant living in a prized location. A mosaic tile entry brings you up to a gracious floor plan with high ceilings, crown moldings, and hardwood floors. The great room includes a formal dining area with wainscoting and built-in hutch, and a chef's kitchen with quartz breakfast bar, mosaic tile backsplash, double ovens, pantry, and five-burner range. The rear family room enjoys green outlooks and an office nook, while the front living room features a bay window with seating bench. The peaceful primary suite offers dual closets and a luxurious bath with soaking tub, separate shower, and dual marble vanities. A second bedroom with dual closets connects to the hall bath; a third bedroom provides flexibility as an office or guest space.
